method: native response.create request + task_complete turn join
experimental_role: post-hoc development on the museum image; hash-frozen before retrospective checks on the earlier retained CLI images, not a prospective held-out experiment
join_rule: In one native process, select a complete response.create object whose client_metadata supplies thread_id and turn_id, require exactly one input item tagged user.text for that turn, and join to one task_complete with the same turn_id. Conflicting thread, input, or completion variants remain ambiguous.
identifier_boundary: The recovered input ID is a model-input message ID, not the app-server user-item ID. task_complete does not independently bind an assistant-message ID.
